title: MSA One 53 available
message: MSA One 53 introduces the new Workspace UI with universal search, Home, Files, Tools, AI assistants, Template Center and drawer navigation.
releaseNotes: New workspace shell with Home, Files, Create, Tools and AI bottom navigation
Universal search across files, tools, templates and AI assistants
Files V2 with type filters, storage sources and reusable action sheet
Side drawer for Planner, Library, Settings, Backup, Update and Security
Build 52 Office/PDF/native-file engines remain unchanged underneath
